name: Dharmendra Pradhan
quote: My young friends, for more than four decades I have devoted myself to the cause of students, teachers, and educational reforms. I decided to step down so your futures do not remain trapped in a long political or legal dispute.

name: Narendra Modi
quote: Announced fast-track courts for paper-leak prosecutions on Jul 23, 2026, as protests over the NEET-UG leak and CBSE marking crisis entered their eighth week.

name: J.P. Nadda
role: Union Health Minister; government negotiator with protest leaders
quote: Co-signed written assurances to Sonam Wangchuk on Jul 23, 2026, pledging to withdraw cases against non-violent protesters and compensate suicide victims' families.

name: Jitendra Singh Rana
role: Union Minister; government negotiator with protest leaders
quote: Joined J.P. Nadda in negotiating the Jul 25, 2026 settlement that ended the 50-day Jantar Mantar occupation.

name: Abhijeet Dipke
quote: Warned that any suppression of the protest would spark citywide demonstrations, and vowed the movement would continue until Pradhan resigned.

name: Sonam Wangchuk
role: Education reformer and environmentalist; 26-day hunger striker
quote: This movement has no political colour — it is an appeal for accountability and reform in how India runs its examinations.

name: Neha Bora
role: National President, All India Students' Association (AISA)
quote: Joined Sonam Wangchuk's indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar on Jun 28, 2026, alongside five other AISA activists.

name: Adarsh M. Saji
quote: Announced he would join the hunger strike after Wangchuk's forcible hospitalization on Jul 18, 2026.

name: Aishe Ghosh
role: Joint Secretary, Students' Federation of India (SFI)
quote: Joined the hunger strike in solidarity after Delhi Police removed Sonam Wangchuk from the protest site on Jul 18, 2026.

name: Rahul Gandhi
quote: Led Congress MPs to Prime Minister Modi's residence in protest on Jul 21, 2026, and said Modi had 'psychologically collapsed' in his handling of the exam crisis.

name: Mallikarjun Kharge
quote: Led the Jul 21, 2026 Congress march to PM Modi's residence demanding accountability for the NEET and CBSE crises; briefly detained by police.

name: Sandeep Lamba
role: Deputy Commissioner of Police, Delhi Police
quote: Filmed appearing to slap a female protester during the Jul 20, 2026 crackdown; activist Saket Gokhale filed an FIR complaint over the incident.

name: Surya Kant
quote: His May 2026 remark comparing unemployed youth and social-media activists to 'cockroaches' and 'parasites' inspired the movement's name; he later rejected a petition on police brutality without reviewing video evidence.

name: D.K. Upadhyaya
quote: His bench declined to hold an urgent hearing on allegations of excessive police force on Jul 21, 2026, but separately ordered Wangchuk's hospital transfer at his request.

name: Ratna Singh
quote: Called the PIL seeking an NIA probe into the protest movement's alleged foreign funding 'politically motivated.'

name: Vinod Jakhar
role: National President, National Students' Union of India (NSUI)
quote: The mistake is NTA's, but the punishment is for the students — we demand that NTA be scrapped and its chairman resign.

name: Devendra Nath Mahto
role: Jharkhand Loktantrik Kranti Morcha leader; face of the JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch protest
quote: I have ended my hunger strike, not the protest.

name: Hemant Soren
quote: We will move ahead with complete transparency — everything associated with TDPL has been cancelled.

name: Deepak Roshan
quote: Stayed the Jharkhand government's cancellation of JPSC and JSSC recruitment exams and appointments on Aug 20–21, 2026, in Deepmala & Ors v. State of Jharkhand & Ors, with the next hearing set for Sep 15, 2026.

name: Harisharan Devgan
role: Social activist; Supreme Court petitioner on JPSC exam-rigging allegations
quote: Filed an Article 32 petition alleging a candidate qualified the JPSC prelims despite attempting only 48 of 100 questions, prompting the Supreme Court to issue notice to the Centre, Jharkhand government, JPSC and CBI on Aug 24, 2026.

name: Samrat Choudhary
quote: The government has been serious about the demands of students from the very beginning. Now, a decision has been taken... that this year's TRE-4 examination will be conducted in a single phase.

name: Rajesh Kumar Singh
role: Examination Controller, Bihar Public Service Commission (suspended Aug 24, 2026)
quote: Hathi chale bazaar, kutta bhaunke hazar — the remark was twisted and presented out of context; I had no intention of hurting the sentiments of any individual or group.
